heading.title: Six steps.
heading.description: From the first call to long after launch, you always know what's happening and what comes next.

items.title: Discovery call
items.blurb: Reach out and book a free first call to explain your vision. Within 2–3 business days we walk you through the plan, pricing and timeline (one revision included), then finalise on a third free call. Extra calls are ₹2,000 / $50.

items.title: UI/UX design
items.blurb: We sketch, moodboard and prototype in Figma, iterating with you until the concept feels exactly like you imagined it.

items.title: Development
items.blurb: We build your product with clean, scalable code, showing progress along the way so there are no surprises.

items.title: Testing
items.blurb: We test and refine every detail so what reaches your users is reliable and matches your vision.

items.title: Launch
items.blurb: We deploy your product live and make sure the launch goes smoothly.

items.title: Support & maintenance
items.blurb: We don't leave your side after launch. Updates, bug fixes and improvements keep your product healthy as it grows.
